Hi Elena — thanks for the note and great working with you last week. I put together three concise reservation options below (PDF attached with cost appendix and SLA table). TL;DR included at top.

TL;DR — three proposals tailored to expected usage bands; each includes a min GPU floor, ramp milestones, and recommended soft-fallbacks.

Option A — Entry anchor (min floor, low upfront)- Cluster: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (single availability zone)- Minimum guaranteed floor: 6 GPUs reserved (always available)- Expected steady-state throughput: ~70 tokens/sec sustained for 8k context (cluster-level, burst capable)- Ramp: Week 0–2: 4 reserved GPUs (trial), Week 3–6: increase to 6 reserved GPUs, Week 7–12: evaluate to add burst pool or convert to 8 reserved GPUs- Warm-up: 50k token warm-up credits; auto-prefetch for top 10 prefixes- Fallbacks: automatic spill to preemptible capacity with model-smaller fallback (latency +30–50ms)

Option B — Growth lane (recommended for initial production)- Cluster: 16 x A100-equivalent GPUs (cross-AZ pair)- Minimum guaranteed floor: 12 GPUs reserved- Expected throughput: ~150 tokens/sec sustained; supports multi-tenant workloads- Ramp: Week 0–2: provision 8 reserved GPUs with canary routing, Week 3–6: increase to 12 reserved GPUs, Week 7–12: full 16 reserved GPUs or enable burst window to 24 GPUs for peak days- Warm-up: 200k token credits; KV cache priming on your top-20 prompts- Fallbacks: model variant routing + cross-region fallback to ensure SLA

Option C — Anchored capacity (high-availability, long-term)- Cluster: 32 x A100-equivalent GPUs (multi-AZ; SLA-backed)- Minimum guaranteed floor: 24 GPUs reserved (SLA: 99.95% availability for the floor)- Expected throughput: ~320 tokens/sec sustained; supports heavy batch and streaming workloads- Ramp: Week 0–4: staged activation (8 -> 16), Week 5–10: increase to 24 reserved GPUs, Week 11–12: full cluster activation to 32 GPUs- Warm-up: 500k token credits; dedicated pre-warm nodes and priority scheduling- Fallbacks: automated cross-region failover and pre-negotiated burst credits

Pricing note (high level)- We price reserved floors as a blended monthly commit + per-token overage. See attached PDF for tabulated example pricing for each option and a 12-month smoothing example.

Operational recommendations- Canary route 5–10% traffic for 2 weeks after each step-up in reserved capacity.- Use KV/prefix caching for the top 50 prompts to reduce incremental tokens during ramp.- Implement a short-term burst window (pay-as-you-go) for unpredictable spikes while you test reserve sizing.

Next steps- If Option B looks right, we'll send a formal proposal with contract language, SLA appendix, and an activation calendar. If you'd like, Marissa (our deals lead) can review pricing concessions and ramp credit terms.

I've attached dpops_reserved_proposal_v1.pdf and a service_level_summary.xlsx.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Redwood Inference
